title: MVS intention, terminal and batch authority boundaries
summary: MVS management is discovery-first and asynchronous. Intention retains natural-language semantic state, Terminal Machine supplies terminal/session evidence, MVS Alchemy/JES supplies guest/job/dataset semantics, Hercules Services supplies emulator/control-plane evidence, and independent reference tools may corroborate but never inherit authority.
invariants: ED209Z on ED209C and ED209ZZ on ED209I are distinct guests and scopes; every fact must retain target/host/session provenance.
A connected 3270 session is not proof of authenticated TSO; authentication-sensitive state requires positive semantic screen evidence such as exact-row TSO READY.
AID transmission and host semantic completion are separate; observe a new terminal presentation generation/state rather than treating an emulator scripting call return as completion.
Terminal Machine facts may expose terminal state, fields, cursor, keyboard, LU/device and presentation generation but do not become JES/dataset authority.
s3270/c3270 remains an independent reference oracle and must never be relabelled TERMINAL_MACHINE.
JES batch execution is asynchronous: submission creates/identifies work; completion and correctness are established from JES step codes, diagnostics, spool and domain output artifacts.
Safe discovery may perform many read-only observations before proposing an Intention; wrong scope is more expensive than bounded discovery.
When MVS Alchemy PRE23 completion-gate evidence is present, a facility PASS marker is not success until JES_ENDED=TRUE (HASP395) and SPOOL_RETAINED=TRUE; incomplete evidence must remain INCOMPLETE.
procedure: Resolve the requested guest first and bind the corresponding Linux host/Hercules instance before opening a terminal session.
Observe current terminal state, then use Terminal Machine native field/AID semantics for controlled interaction; retain s3270 as a differential witness.
Keep MVS Alchemy/JES discovery separate for jobs, datasets and guest-native semantics.
For batch requests, retain job ID and follow the job through completion; preserve the first failing spool evidence before repairs.
Re-run identical natural language after authoritative state changes to prove discovery, not the LLM, carries operational state.
